name: deepfilter-full
description: DeepFilterNet3 with no attenuation limit, then the dialogue tone and compression, no expander. For loud non-stationary noise (traffic, wind, crowd, water, keyboard). It writes digital silence in pauses; listen for warbled vowels and swallowed word ends. Ends with a 4x oversampled look-ahead peak limiter that holds true peak 14 dB above the mono voice loudness (11 dB once the mix plays it as dual mono).
